verdicts.reason: I couldn't see any difference between A and B, and both are broken in the same ways. The headline 'Should You / Drink Water' sits directly on the busy hand-and-bottle photo, which breaks the no-text-on-busy-image rule and hurts readability. The decorations have come apart: the '=' dashes float loose, the zigzags crowd 'During', and the right ribbon tail has dropped to the bottom-right corner, away from the yellow 'a Workout?' banner. The text block is also off-center and crammed against the right edge.
